scope: Future deterministic development roles for complete immutable provenance components; no assignment, split, fit or blinded-validation claim

future_algorithm.membership: Preserve original connected membership and source relationships; derive a stable digest from sorted complete membership and relationships using declared length-prefixed encoding
future_algorithm.ordering: After future graph and seed freezes, sort known-containing components by SHA256 of length-prefixed domain, fixed seed and component-membership digest; break a hash tie by membership digest then original group ID
future_algorithm.allocation: For N known-containing groups, start with integer floors of 3N/5, N/5, N/5. Distribute remaining groups by descending fractional remainder, with train/validation/calibration tie order. Refuse if existing 9/3/3 floors or predeclared coverage are not satisfied
future_algorithm.unknown_only_components: Keep complete unknown-only components in development_train provenance accounting, with every unknown excluded from labels and cost/Top metrics; never count them toward labeled-group floors
future_algorithm.known_component_unknown_members: Every member follows its complete component role; unknown members remain unknown and label-ineligible
future_algorithm.transfer: No current assignments. Allow zero transfer-development groups; future scoped source proposals require their own relationship/input freezes

encoding_and_exact_membership_sha: To be frozen in a separate assignment execution plan before assigning any seed or group
coverage_requirements: Pending independent content/source review and a future predeclared role-coverage plan; do not require every one of the 18 prototypes in every role or add a new numeric gate
insufficient_coverage_policy: Stop assignment or fitting without splitting components, lowering existing floors or reselecting favorable seeds/groups
